summary: Baiya International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement on April 17, 2026, with an institutional investor for the purchase of 13,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.312 per share, representing a private placement. The transaction is expected to close in Q2 2026, subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals, including Nasdaq. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a control change, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. The filing is a foreign private issuer report; under US rules it is equivalent to a private placement 8-K event but lacks special-situations triggers. No board recommendation or advisor was named.
